title: Corebridge Financial introduces new digital experience to simplify retirement plan withdrawals
summary: Explore practical retirement planning tips for every career stage, from starting to save to reviewing contributions and preparing for retirement income.
body_markdown:
**5 min read | Published: October 1, 2026**


National Retirement Security Month in October is a timely reminder that retirement readiness is built one decision at a time. Corebridge is proud to support the month by encouraging individuals to take stock of where they are today, where they want to go and what action they can take next—whether they’re just starting out, nearing retirement or somewhere in between.


## Early Career: Start Building the Habit


If you're just beginning your retirement journey, the most important step may be simply getting started. If you're eligible, enroll in your workplace retirement plan and begin contributing regularly. Even modest contributions can add up over time.


### Actions to consider


- Enroll in your workplace retirement plan if you're eligible.


- Set a manageable contribution rate. If available, try contributing enough to qualify for matching contributions.


- Register for online account access so you can monitor and manage your plan. Online access can make it easier to view balances and investment elections, review contributions and account activity, and update personal information.


## Mid-Career: Evaluate Progress and Make Adjustments


For workers in the middle of their careers, it may be time for a checkpoint. Have your retirement goals changed? Are you saving enough to support the lifestyle you envision? Is your investment approach still aligned with your objectives?


### Actions to consider


- Review your balance and contribution rate and consider increasing your savings. Reviewing your budget can help identify room for contribution increases.


- Revisit your allocation strategy to ensure your investments still align with your goals.


- Consider how retirement saving fits alongside other financial priorities.


## Late Career: Confirm You're on Track


As retirement gets closer, it’s important to assess whether your goals are within reach and identify any gaps while there’s still time to adjust.


### Actions to consider


- Review how different retirement ages, health care costs, inflation and market changes could affect your plan.


- If you’re age 50 or older, consider whether catch-up contributions can help strengthen your savings.


- Think through a retirement income strategy, including how workplace plans, pensions, Social Security, personal savings and potential guaranteed income solutions such as annuities may fit together.


## Professional Guidance Can Help at Every Stage


Retirement planning does not have to be a do-it-yourself process. Some workplace retirement plans provide access to financial professionals who can offer personalized guidance. Find out what resources are available through your employer-sponsored plan and consider taking advantage of them.


## Corebridge Tools and Resources


Expanding your financial knowledge can help you take informed action today and support greater retirement confidence tomorrow.


Corebridge offers resources to help you learn, plan and take action.


- [Action Planner Series](https://www.corebridgefinancial.com/insights-education/action-planner?role=pp) : Move forward with educational content and expert insights that help you take action on important financial topics.


- [Retirement Contributions Calculator](https://www.corebridgefinancial.com/rs/home/financial-education/education-center/tools-and-calculators/retirement-contribution-effects-on-your-paycheck-calculator) : Understand the impact of retirement contributions on your paycheck.


- [Budget worksheet](https://my.valic.com/DocumentServices/RetrieveDocument.aspx?appid=sSiXkm%2fGOyJiINB5UnGQGQ%3d%3d&fid=91292) : Identify places you can save in your daily expenses to boost retirement plan contributions.


- [Savings Calculator](https://www.corebridgefinancial.com/rs/home/financial-education/education-center/tools-and-calculators/savings-calculator) : See how even small additions to your retirement contributions add up over time.


- [Retirement Planner Calculator](https://www.corebridgefinancial.com/insights-education/retirement-calculators/retirement-planner-calculator) : Estimate retirement needs and compare them with current savings.


National Retirement Security Month is a reminder that progress starts with action. Whether you enroll, increase your contribution rate, review your investment mix, use a planning tool or meet with a financial professional, taking one step today can help strengthen your path toward a more secure retirement.
